name: monarch-uploader
description: Violentmonkey userscript for uploading Questrade, Wealthsimple, Canada Life, and Rogers Bank data to Monarch Money

scripts.build: npm run clean && vite build --mode production
scripts.build:stable: npm run clean && BUILD_TYPE=stable vite build --mode production
scripts.build:dev-release: npm run clean && BUILD_TYPE=dev vite build --mode production
scripts.build:full: npm run clean && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && vite build --mode production
scripts.build:quick: npm run clean && npm run build:dev

author: Mykhailo Delegan
